description.en: Ontology module for textile repairability-related product aspects, services, guidance, design features, contextual conditions, priority elements, assessments, repair-related process specialisations and their links to EU DPP product-event semantics. The module does not define a universal objective repairability score.

comments.en: The module reuses the semantic product-event classes defined in the EU DPP EVENT module. Textile-specific life-extension event classes bridge those event semantics with concrete textile process executions; EPCIS technical carriers remain defined by the EVENT module.
